environment.description: Rails 7.0 API application deployed on a single EC2 instance running Puma directly (no reverse proxy). Backend microservices on private subnet accept raw HTTP/1.1 connections on port 8080 running Gunicorn with default settings. No request normalization layer between the proxy controller and backend services. Application runs as appuser with standard filesystem access.

config.network: Direct TCP to backend services on 10.0.1.0/24:8080
config.proxy: None - Puma serves directly on port 443
config.backend: Gunicorn 21.2 with default HTTP parsing (prioritizes Transfer-Encoding over Content-Length)
